topic: Practical's on making entries in (specific A/C A700 / MOD Form 700 and MF 700
syllabus_extract: Practical’s on making entries in (specific A/C A700 / MOD Form 700 and MF 700
specific_objectives: 29.1.1.3 Trainee will be able to explain basic documentation used in aircraft maintenance

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Trainees will practice filling out MOD Form 700 and MF 700 for A700 aircraft maintenance entries. Safety precautions include handling forms carefully and verifying data accuracy. Instructor supervision will ensure correct entry formats and adherence to documentation standards.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of MOD Form 700?
Which aircraft type is the focus of this documentation?
Why is accurate entry in maintenance forms critical?

development.content:
Overview of MOD Form 700 structure
Key fields in MOD Form 700
Data entry requirements for A700
Common errors in form completion

MF 700 form layout and sections
Entry procedures for MF 700
Cross-referencing MOD Form 700 data
Verification of completed entries

Review of completed forms
Identification of entry discrepancies
Correction techniques for errors
Final submission checklist

summary_questions: What are the key differences between MOD Form 700 and MF 700?
How do you verify the accuracy of maintenance entries?
What steps should be taken if an entry error is discovered?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the proper sequence for filling out MOD Form 700 and MF 700 for the next lesson on tool control procedures.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction and explanation on proper tool control procedure: (a) Demonstration to standard tool control procedure (b) Calibration of tools, labeling and record of servicing done. (c) Color coding of tools and tool outfit.
